      epsilon * (m : ℝ) - totalSize m < 20 * microSize m) ∧
    0 ≤ (-beta) * (totalSize m : ℝ) - bandExponent m ∧

payload.natural_language_statement: For every natural bit parameter $m$, the executable even microblock size $s(m)$ is divisible by two and the block count $J(m)$ by twenty. Whenever $s(m)>0$, the exact total size obeys $0\le e m-\mu(m)<20s(m)$.
